primary_comparison.quality: mean normalized reference-key-point score per question across three repeats, then paired question difference
primary_comparison.incremental_cost: paired per-question answer request cost, excluding separately reported shared setup and judge costs; unknown charges stay null
primary_comparison.judge_failure: missing, never quality zero; primary paired analysis requires all three known repeats for both variants; disclose exclusions and missing-value sensitivity bounds
primary_comparison.unexecuted: separate incomplete status, never successful or scored execution

statistics.interval: two-sided percentile interval, exploratory with few families

judge.rubric: same exhaustive answer-block and key-point rules as dev-block-v2; no development-only reference overlay on test

source_review_sample.selection_rule: seeded draws of two questions per task-type/language stratum; first draw covering every test document family; no answer content used
source_review_sample.human_review_status: pending; never imputed from AI review

remaining_before_paid_test: freeze validated runner and test judge hashes
bind each repeat and resume to immutable configuration/data/source identity
attribute setup/query requests explicitly across resumed processes
offline proof of no duplicate paid completed units and no gold leakage
commit final freeze record before first held-out request
design.optional_cross_model_replication: excluded from this main execution stage; requires its own protocol before generating its answers

unit_interruption_policy: stop; explicit resolution may retain failure, never regenerate the uncertain unit
setup_policy: separate index ledger; every resumed setup retained
